hints.title: Contiguous Decreasing Sequences
hints.text: Consecutive 'D' characters form decreasing runs that must be reversed to obtain the lexicographically smallest digits.

hints.title: Stack Reversal
hints.text: Push digits (1, 2, ..., n + 1) sequentially onto a stack. When encountering 'I' or the end of pattern, pop all stacked digits into the output.

hints.title: Greedy Digit Order
hints.text: This guarantees that increasing positions receive the smallest available digits while decreasing blocks are reversed minimally.

hints.title: Stack Reversal Implementation

complexity.notes: Each digit from 1 to n + 1 is pushed and popped exactly once.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all permutations of digits 1 through 9 takes O(9!).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Stack stores at most n + 1 digits.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies stack reversal over decreasing runs to produce lexicographically smallest sequence.
